title: Titanium Wafer Handling End-Effector
function: Robot end-effector vacuum pad for wafer handling
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Grade 5, UNS R56400) was selected for this wafer handling application because its 900+ MPa tensile enables thin-wall lightweighting under cyclic loading. The alpha-beta microstructure provides 45% higher specific strength than 4140 steel, critical for weight-sensitive designs. Its 6.7 W/mK thermal conductivity simplifies thermal management. This rationale is driven by robot end-effector vacuum pad for wafer handling and fat life requirements.
process: Cleanroom CNC Class 100 for wafer handling geometry
UHP DI water cascade rinse at 200W fiber laser
Particle count MIL-STD-1246 at 200W fiber laser
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing Ra <0.25um + UHP DI cascade rinse with particle count verification per MIL-STD-1246 Class 1
commonFailures: Virtual leak from dead-leg threaded connections - remedied by VCR/Swagelok face-seal fittings

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Wafer Handling End-Effector suitable for Robot end-effector vacuum pad for wafer handling?
faq.a: Titanium Wafer Handling End-Effector uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address wafer handling operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Wafer Handling End-Effector?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Wafer Handling End-Effector require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. wafer handling components receive Electropolishing Ra <0.25um + UHP DI cascade rinse with particle count verification per MIL-STD-1246 Class 1. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Wafer Handling End-Effector shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements; (4) Surface roughness certification on critical features. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for End-effector / Wafer pad wafer handling components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
